content: Turborepo + Prisma: dev/build tasks must declare dependsOn ^db:generate or new devs hit missing-client errors on first turbo dev. Prisma generate output is cacheable but Turborepo has had bugs where cached generated client isn't restored to node_modules. DATABASE_URL must be in turbo.json globalEnv for correct task hashing; keep migrate deploy uncached (not a pure build output).
